title: Lucky Hours, 500 CFA francs

specs.Decoration: digital printing, laser frosting, crystal insert, microprinting

descriptionPlain: Description The coin combines well-known symbols of luck in a light, clear design. A four-leaf clover, a horseshoe, a gold elephant, and a ladybug – each motif is meant to bring good fortune. The modern design, inspired by a clock mechanism, reminds us that sometimes you need to help luck along by seizing the right moment. Colorful decorations and a crystal insert give the coin an elegant character, making it a perfect gift for someone you wish happiness to.
